**Trial Status:** The Phase 1/2 study was commenced in May 2010 and completed in March 2011.

**Efficacy Data:** Urinary GAG reduction has been used as the main efficacy measurement. The uGAG level is considered a reliable indicator of biologic activity *in vivo*, and in some cases is predictive of clinical efficacy.
